text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Windy, happy birthday! I brought Air
Groove
along to celebrate too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Guh, I appreciate it, but also why?! You
brought
the scariest person imaginable!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Windy, you tried biting into the
academy gates
again, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, you are forgiven. Just this once. I'll
turn a
blind eye on account of it being
your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Is... is this real life?! Hold on, this
could be
my big chance!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove... I'm the one who trampled
your
flower bed! It happened when Taiki
and I were
playing tag.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Usually I do it on purpose, but that time,
just that
once, it was an accident! Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why, you little... Well, it's your special
day. As
long as you're sorry, I'll look
past that too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Today, you take another step toward
being an
adult—one who doesn't cause
trouble for others,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... Uh-huh! Might be impossible,
but I
promise!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's great, Windy! You even got us off
the hook
for the flower bed
incident—that's double
happiness! ☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: About the flower bed... I never said I'd let you off the hook, Taiki.
